text:
olivia-design: dropping updated frames for RBAC table + Invite modal. Looking for quick UX + accessibility review before I hand off to eng. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/rbac-invite-v5

mike-ux: skim done. Two quick things: role matrix looks noisy because of inheritance badges; suggest collapsing inherited perms under a chevron. Invite modal: make expiry wording explicit.

anna-product: legal wants clear owner trail. Do we surface Owner role or hide it? If hidden, need an obvious audit path.

samir-eng: backend stores owner events. UI can hide owner role row but add a clear "View audit" affordance in role details that opens audit log with a pre-applied filter.

olivia-design: plan: small inline link on role rows "View audit" -> audit?filter=role:owner. Less columns, more discoverable.

jess-security: +1 but ensure keyboard focus and aria-labels. Audit links must be shareable and include filters. Also require invite events to log creator, role, and expiry.

designbot: updated Figma comments: accessibility checklist added, frames revised for compact inheritance.

mike-ux: copy suggestions for invite modal: label "Invite teammates", helper "Invitation link expires after 7 days.", primary "Send invite". Advanced options to reveal expiry (1d/7d/30d/never) + role selector.

olivia-design: added Advanced toggle and a small "Require SSO for this invite" checkbox hidden in advanced options per security ask.

anna-product: enterprise-only option: allow "never" expiry only for enterprise orgs. Note: invite list UI should surface expiry and allow revoke.

samir-eng: noted. Will add invite.created event {creator_id, role, expiry_seconds} and API for saved filters for audit log.

jess-security: audit log header should show retention: "Retention: 30 days (365d for enterprise)" and an Export button (CSV/JSON). Also saved filters for common queries: Invites, Role changes, SSO toggles.

mike-ux: accessibility nit: role chips contrast — use #0058d6 with white text; increase row focus to 3px solid outline. Tooltips must be reachable via keyboard.

olivia-design: will update styles and annotate focus order and aria-labels in the handoff notes. If no other bikeshedding, I'll send PR to eng with copies and a11y checklist by EOD.

samir-eng: I'll watch for the PR and spec saved_filter CRUD.

last action: olivia-design pinned Figma link and tagged @anna-product
